notes.title: DogFight version 1.03
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed text align bug
[*] Fixed bug with 'invite friend' to online game
[*] Added kick option in lobby menu
[*] Possible to choose between 3, 5, 10 and 15 rounds in skirmish games
[*] Updated GM engine version
[/list]

notes.title: Old Dog Fight versions
notes.notes:
The old versions of DogFight are now included in the game. 
You can start them through the game or find them in the game folder /olddogfight.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33591890/1c9d78cadf1c61aec6df31676b50927a98ccb773.png[/img]

The two most popular versions of DogFight are now Open Source. 
You can find the sourcecode on GitHub: 
[list]
[*] https://github.com/Nosceteipsum/DogFight3
[*] https://github.com/Nosceteipsum/DogFightUltraDeluxe
[/list]

if you have any questions feel free to contact me and I will do my best to help.
